Title: General Availability: Azure Monitor for containers is now available in Azure China

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor for containers is now available in Azure China. Azure Monitor for containers provides end to end Kubernetes monitoring for AKS from infrastructure to the workloads.

For more information about Azure Monitor for containers, please visit the documentation page.
